title: Philadelphia : Custom Walking Tour with A Guide (Private Tour)
includes: Help from our team to book the tickets for the desired visits.
Meet up at your accommodation (If located in the city) or cruise terminal
Drink or Food ( If you want to have a break during the tour ) (not included)
Local transportation around the city (it’s a walking tour, car transportation isn’t included) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Philadelphia’s rich history and iconic landmarks can sometimes feel overwhelming. Take the mystery out of your visit by exploring with a local on a private walking tour. 
This personalized tour allows you to discover the exterior of monuments, including museums, while learning about the city’s history and culture. If you wish to include a museum visit, your guide can customize the itinerary to fit your interests—just let us know in advance. 
Your guide contacts you beforehand to understand your preferences, ensuring you see the places you truly want to experience. Ideal for families, solo travelers, or couples, this tour uncovers Philadelphia’s hidden treasures and local stories.
